primary_version: Sony EE Core Instruction Set Manual6.0
retained_material: Manufacturer numeric encodings and instruction names; locally authored typed lowering and resource metadata. Independent references were cross-checks; no emulator implementation was copied.

scope_boundary.claim: The 132 generated recipes are a bounded EE/MMI catalog, not an exhaustive claim for every R5900/Emotion Engine or Vector Unit instruction.
excluded: The separate VU0 COP2 macro-mode vector instruction set.
VU-specific COP2 quadword data/control-transfer encodings, including QMFC2/QMTC2.
scope_boundary.included: Finite catalog of EE scalar overrides, MMI packed-integer operations, EE single-precision COP1/accumulator operations, and the listed CP0 control/performance-counter transfer forms. Ordinary legal scalar/COP1 transfers can be delegated to the common native backend.
